<@&688090867927482525>  quick q on fcuV4 targetGasLimit: #35514 made it optional for glam8. On master, attributes without it (or with null) still return VALID and build toward the local --miner.gaslimit. The spec has it required (-38003), and Erigon/Nethermind reject it.

Was that devnet-only, or meant to stay optional? Happy to PR the check back if it should be required.
